page: Microsoft Azure D96ds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv6 family. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz, featuring 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs via hyperthreading on the x86_64 architecture. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated vector and matrix operations. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance features 5669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable. In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong multi-core performance, achieving a top-tier Geekbench multi-core score of 21967.0 and a top-tier Passmark CPU score of 86698.13. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only large block bandwidth reaching 257.11 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at 107.03 GB/sec. The local storage and high memory throughput support demanding database operations, as reflected in a strong Passmark database score of 32248.97 and 107.53 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks.

The D96ds_v6 is optimized for workloads requiring substantial parallel processing, high-speed local storage, and balanced memory-to-CPU ratios. It excels in static web serving, software compilation, and image processing, where it achieves top-tier benchmark results. Additionally, the inclusion of Intel AMX instructions enables strong performance in CPU-based machine learning tasks, such as LLM inference, where it processes 282.63 tokens per second for medium-sized 7B models. This server is highly suitable for relational databases, enterprise applications, large-scale CI/CD pipelines, and data processing tasks.
